cases.title: Missing and poor image alternatives
cases.userImpact: A non-visual user may miss the product image or receive an unhelpful generic description.
manualReviewItems: Confirm the product description is accurate and the second image is truly decorative.
allowedFixes: Add an owner-supported meaningful alternative.
Use empty alt only for a genuinely decorative image.
prohibitedFixes: Fabricate an alternative from the file name.
Hide an informative image from assistive technology.
regressionRisks: Alternative becomes stale when product imagery changes.

cases.title: Unlabeled form field
cases.userImpact: A user may not know which value the input expects.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: The email field exposes the visible label Email address.
manualReviewItems: Confirm the label wording matches product intent.
allowedFixes: Associate a visible label with the input.
prohibitedFixes: Use placeholder text as the only label.
Invent a label without product context.
regressionRisks: Generated IDs break the label association.

cases.title: Invalid form error is not exposed
cases.userImpact: A user may not discover why submission failed or which field needs correction.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Invalid submission exposes an alert.
Focus moves to the error summary.
The field is marked invalid and connected to its error.
manualReviewItems: Assess whether the recovery instructions are clear.
allowedFixes: Expose and focus a concise error summary.
Associate field error text and invalid state.
prohibitedFixes: Disable validation.
Show error color without text or programmatic state.
regressionRisks: Duplicate live announcements.
Stale invalid state after correction.

cases.title: Custom control lacks button behavior
cases.userImpact: Keyboard and assistive-technology users cannot reliably invoke the action.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: The action is a native button and responds to standard keyboard input.
manualReviewItems: Confirm action naming and state feedback.
allowedFixes: Replace the simulated control with a native button.
prohibitedFixes: Add only role=button without keyboard behavior.
Remove the action.
regressionRisks: CSS assumes a div selector.

cases.title: Modal dialog lets focus escape
cases.userImpact: A keyboard user can operate obscured background controls and lose dialog context.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Tab and Shift+Tab remain in the open modal.
manualReviewItems: Assess initial focus choice at zoom and mobile widths.
allowedFixes: Use native modal dialog behavior.
Implement tested containment for a necessary custom dialog.
prohibitedFixes: Set aria-modal without making the background inert.
Remove keyboard focus from dialog controls.
regressionRisks: Nested overlays break containment.

cases.title: Dialog close loses the invoker
cases.userImpact: After closing, a keyboard user must rediscover their former location.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to its invoker.
manualReviewItems: Choose a logical successor if the invoker is removed.
allowedFixes: Restore focus to the invoker on close.
prohibitedFixes: Always move focus to the document body.
regressionRisks: Invoker unmounts before close.

cases.title: Focus indicator is removed
cases.userImpact: Sighted keyboard users cannot locate the active control.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Keyboard focus has a visible, high-contrast indicator.
manualReviewItems: Inspect focus on every background and in forced-colors mode.
allowedFixes: Add a robust :focus-visible style.
prohibitedFixes: Remove outlines without an equivalent indicator.
regressionRisks: Component styles override the shared focus token.

cases.title: Positive tabindex changes task order
cases.userImpact: Keyboard focus moves in an order that does not match the interface.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Tab order follows the logical source and visual sequence.
manualReviewItems: Judge the sequence against the actual user task.
allowedFixes: Align source order and remove positive tabindex values.
prohibitedFixes: Set a larger collection of positive tabindex values.
regressionRisks: Responsive reordering diverges from DOM order.

cases.title: Menu does not implement its keyboard model
cases.userImpact: Keyboard users cannot move efficiently among composite widget items.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Arrow keys move focus and roving tabindex maintains one tab stop.
manualReviewItems: Confirm a menu, rather than ordinary buttons, is the correct pattern.
allowedFixes: Use ordinary buttons if no composite is needed.
Implement the established menu keyboard model.
prohibitedFixes: Add menu roles without arrow-key behavior.
regressionRisks: Dynamic items invalidate the focused index.

cases.title: Heading hierarchy and primary landmark are missing
cases.userImpact: Structural navigation and page scanning become harder.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: The skip link reaches the main landmark.
allowedFixes: Use a coherent heading outline and one primary main landmark.
prohibitedFixes: Choose heading levels for font size alone.
regressionRisks: Nested layouts introduce multiple main landmarks.

cases.title: Dynamic status is not announced
cases.userImpact: A screen-reader user may not know that a save completed.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: The status container exposes an appropriate live status role before its text changes.
manualReviewItems: Check announcement timing and duplication with a screen reader.
allowedFixes: Use a stable role=status container for non-urgent updates.
prohibitedFixes: Move focus for every passive save update.
Use assertive alerts for routine status.
regressionRisks: Container is mounted only after the text update.

cases.title: Animation ignores reduced-motion preference
cases.userImpact: Persistent movement can cause discomfort or impede task completion.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Non-essential animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
manualReviewItems: Determine whether any remaining motion is essential.
allowedFixes: Disable or reduce non-essential motion for the preference.
prohibitedFixes: Remove essential status information with the animation.
regressionRisks: New animation class bypasses the preference rule.

cases.title: Text contrast is insufficient
cases.userImpact: People with low vision may not be able to read important information.
manualReviewItems: Check text over all dynamic backgrounds and forced-colors behavior.
allowedFixes: Adjust the foreground or background while retaining information and hierarchy.
prohibitedFixes: Hide low-contrast content.
Increase font weight without verifying the actual ratio.
regressionRisks: Theme tokens reintroduce the failing color pair.

cases.title: Help content appears only on pointer hover
cases.userImpact: Keyboard, touch, and magnification users may not discover or keep help visible.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: The trigger is keyboard focusable and exposes the same help on focus.
manualReviewItems: Verify dismissibility, hoverability, persistence, zoom, and touch behavior.
allowedFixes: Use a focusable trigger and associate a persistent tooltip or disclosure.
prohibitedFixes: Make the help permanently invisible to assistive technology.
regressionRisks: Pointer and focus event timing diverge.

cases.title: Whole-code paste loses digits
cases.userImpact: A person using clipboard assistance cannot complete the OTP challenge without transcription.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Pasting 012345 fills all six positions and Verify code succeeds.
Invalid and expired codes can be corrected or resent without losing leading zeroes.
manualReviewItems: Test real screen-reader error discovery and supported password-manager/mobile autofill.
allowedFixes: Distribute a complete pasted code or use a native whole-code input while preserving the challenge.
prohibitedFixes: Remove MFA or code validation.
Treat fill() as proof of clipboard support.
regressionRisks: A code beginning with zero is parsed as a number.

cases.title: Grid editing loses record identity after sorting
cases.userImpact: A keyboard user can unknowingly continue editing the wrong product after saving.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Save Apples quantity as 5; the reordered grid keeps focus on Apples quantity.
Arrow navigation, cancelled edits, and Tab exit remain usable.
manualReviewItems: Check spoken row/column context with the supported screen reader.
allowedFixes: Restore focus by record and column identity after sorting.
prohibitedFixes: Disable sorting or editing.
Make every cell an independent tab stop.
regressionRisks: Row indices are mistaken for record identities.

cases.title: Streaming response uses interrupting live exposure
cases.userImpact: A screen-reader user may be interrupted repeatedly as partial response text arrives.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Response content remains navigable and routine tokens are not exposed through an assertive live ancestor.
Focus remains on the initiating control and completion status is exposed.
Stop, failure, and retry invalidate obsolete callbacks.
manualReviewItems: Listen for actual timing, duplication and interruption; DOM exposure is not speech evidence.
allowedFixes: Separate useful status feedback from token-by-token content while retaining stop and retry.
prohibitedFixes: Hide the response from assistive technology.
Remove response streaming or move focus for every token.
regressionRisks: Cancelled work announces completion or overwrites a later response.

cases.title: Obsolete suggestions replace current query results
cases.userImpact: A user can select a city that no longer matches their query or lose the active option.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Complete lo before l: current options and active reference still identify the lo results.
Enter commits London after the obsolete l response.
Empty/error/retry, text editing, Escape, and Tab remain usable.
manualReviewItems: Check active-option speech, mobile interaction, and IME composition.
allowedFixes: Ignore superseded responses and keep active option state consistent with current results.
prohibitedFixes: Remove autocomplete or keyboard selection.
Use a debounce as the only response-order protection.
regressionRisks: An old response reopens a dismissed popup.

cases.title: Chart filter leaves detailed data stale
cases.userImpact: A nonvisual reader receives different sales figures from those shown visually.
behaviorAssertionsExpected: Q2 chart and detailed table both expose Apples 30 and Pears 0 units.
Empty selection removes old values; Q1 reset restores matching values and context.
manualReviewItems: Confirm descriptions preserve meaning and test chart discovery, filtering and exact-value retrieval with AT.
allowedFixes: Render chart and table from the same filtered dataset.
prohibitedFixes: Hide the data table.
Fabricate a trend or replace a missing value with zero.
regressionRisks: Filter context changes in only one representation.

negativeControls.protectedBehavior: A native button obtains its name from visually hidden text; redundant aria-label is unnecessary.
A decorative image intentionally uses empty alt and must not receive fabricated prose.
A read-only value remains focusable and available for copying.
A native details element provides disclosure behavior without redundant ARIA.
Native credential and whole-code inputs remain usable without unnecessary ARIA or security changes.
A native data table remains a table rather than gaining an unnecessary grid keyboard model.
Native details content remains discoverable without adding a live region.
A native select retains its browser-provided selection model.
Accurate visible sales context and a table remain available without per-value tab stops.
